e7_s4_rationale: The patient has a history of breast-conserving surgery, endocrine therapy, and radiation to the left breast for a previous carcinoma, and now presents with a new lump in a different quadrant of the same breast, which has increased in size on follow-up, suggesting a possible recurrence of breast cancer.

e7_s4_rejected.label: Phyllodes tumor
e7_s4_rejected.why: While possible, the history of previous breast cancer and radiation therapy makes recurrence more likely

e7_s4_rejected.label: Sarcoma of the breast
e7_s4_rejected.why: Sarcomas are rare and the presentation is not typical for a primary breast sarcoma

e7_s4_rejected.label: Radiation-induced fibrosis
e7_s4_rejected.why: The lesion's increase in size and the patient's history of breast cancer make recurrence more likely than fibrosis

e7_s4_rejected.label: Malignant phyllodes tumor
e7_s4_rejected.why: Similar to phyllodes tumor, the history of previous breast cancer and radiation therapy makes recurrence more likely
